title: Bloq Quantum Launches Bloq Maya AI Agent to Streamline Enterprise Quantum Algorithm Development - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Quantum software developer Bloq Quantum has announced the commercial launch of Bloq Maya, an agentic AI assistant designed to automate circuit design, algorithm formulation, and code generation for enterprise quantum development.

Bloq Maya integrates directly into the company’s unified workspace, providing a conversational interface that converts high-level use-case requirements into executable quantum code, parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs), and Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) mathematical models. By automating environment configuration and algorithm construction, the platform aims to reduce development timelines for corporate R&D teams across financial risk modeling, portfolio optimization, logistics, and pharmaceutical simulations.

Use arrow keys when focused.[ Core Operational Features of Bloq Maya ]Platform ModuleFunctional Capabilities & Technical Scope• Low-Code Algorithm Library• Access to over 15 pre-built, research-grade quantum algorithms, including QKAN, PQK, QEMCMC, and QSVM.• Visual Circuit Studio• Drag-and-drop interface for composing parameterized quantum circuits, feature maps, and complex gate sequences.• Experiments Module• Integrated testing environment for benchmarking problem formulations against classical and quantum solvers.• Hardware-Agnostic Execution• Write-once deployment across cloud simulators and physical QPUs, including IBM Quantum and AWS Braket.

This deployment expands Bloq Quantum’s enterprise software ecosystem, building upon Bloq Quantum’s launch of its unified low-code algorithm platform and its strategic workforce and education alliances.
